system.description:
Requirements: Training (3) or Expertise (3) in Arcana

You have discovered the dangerous art of weaving two spells together.

As an Action on your turn, you can attempt to dual-cast.

Select two different spells you know and make a casting check with a Difficulty equal to the highest of the two spells, and a Complexity equal to the combined Complexity of both spells.

For example, spells with DC 4:2 and 5:1 would have a DC of 5:3.

If this check is successful, both spells are cast, with additional successes applying to both spells.

You may select different targets for each spell cast this way.

If this check fails, something goes horribly wrong. Roll twice on the Arcane Mishap table and apply the highest result.
